text:
alex: heads-up — putting a draft instrumentation contract for AB rollouts on the table. need eng-runtime + infra + product feedback. tl;dr: comparable per-variant metrics (latency, errors, cost, quality delta) and signal defs for regression alerts.
maya: +1. can you list the concrete metric names and tags we expect from runtime? that'll help infra wire dashboards. :eyes:
alex: sure — thinking minimal set: `request.count`, `request.success_rate`, `request.error_rate`, `latency.p50_ms`, `latency.p95_ms`, `tokens.generated`, `cost.tokens_usd`, `quality.eval_score` (per prompt set). tags: `rollout_id`, `variant` (control/canary), `model`, `route`, `region`, `customer_tier`.
priya: for `quality.eval_score` we should define normalization and sampling. proposals: 1) sample 1% of requests and run golden prompts offline, 2) user-reported feedback counter. both emit `quality.sampled_score_mean` and `quality.sampled_score_count`.
sam: alerting perspective — want derived signals: `delta.latency_p95_percent` (canary vs control), `delta.error_rate` (absolute and relative), `delta.quality_score` with one-sided test. can we compute these in telemetry rather than each dashboard?
alex: prefer compute in analytics layer (asset dashboards) but runtime should expose raw aggregates by tags and short windows (1m,5m,1h). infra can compute deltas and KS/p-value if needed.
jen: privacy note — any sampled payloads for eval must have PII scrubbed. add tag `sample_scrubbed=true/false`. also require opt-out per-customer.
luis: deployment bot: rollout 5823 started for model:redwood-3b variant:canary (automated message).
deploy-bot: deploy: rollout_id=5823 variant=canary model=redwood-3b region=us-west initiated by @jen
maya: alex — can you drop a quick promql example we can use as a baseline for dashboards?
alex: yup. example PromQL (aggregate per-variant p95 latency):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, rollout_id, variant, model))
```
for error rate: `sum(rate(request_errors_total[5m])) by (rollout_id,variant) / sum(rate(request_total[5m])) by (rollout_id,variant)`
priya: and cost per request: `sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[5m])) by (rollout_id,variant,model) * model_price_per_token` (model price looked up in infra mapping).
sam: question on cardinality — rollout_id + model + route + region could explode. can we restrict high-cardinality tags in the 1m window and add a synthetic `rollout_group` tag for dashboards?
alex: yep — runtime will emit `rollout_group` (short id) and we can set `route` optional for 1m metrics, full route at 1h. add sampling_rate tag for sampled quality metrics.
jen: UX ask from product: dashboards should show side-by-side comparison (control vs canary) with an inline table of deltas and p-values, and a simple pass/fail state. we'll provide a wireframe soon.
maya: infra note — we'll need a contract doc: list of metrics, labels, cardinality guidance, example queries, and retention windows. shall we put that in the eng-platform repo under /telemetry/rollouts?
alex: yes please. i'll draft a markdown with the examples and tests. tagging @priya @sam for review.
priya: will add eval sampling details and the statistical test recipe (bootstrap + KS) tomorrow.
sam: i'll add alert thresholds for staging and prod (separate defaults). can we aim to have the first dashboard prototype by EOW? :calendar:
alex: EOW is tight but doable if infra gives skeleton metrics. pushing draft now.
jen: awesome, thanks everyone. :party_parrot: if anyone wants to pair on the wireframe ping me.
luis: noted — will watch telemetry after rollout 5823 and share early numbers in #eng-platform.
